The structure of Ho20Al4Pb8 (reduced formula Ho5AlPb2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Pb centers each surrounded by 12 Ho neighbors, while Ho centers have 16 neighbors (8 Al, 8 Pb) in body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Al- and Pb-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and corner- and face-sharing between Ho-centered 16-vertex polyhedra.
